description.en: Polished drop-in components and sleek interactive cards for digital products.
description.zh: 针对数字产品与科技页面精心雕琢的即插即用 React 交互卡片与微组件。

content.en: Nexvyn UI delivers meticulously crafted, modern drop-in React components tailored for high-converting SaaS interfaces and developer landing pages. Built with Tailwind CSS, it offers glowing border cards, subtle hovering states, and modern layout primitives.
content.zh: Nexvyn UI 是一套专注于打磨细微视觉品质与交互手感的即插即用型 React 组件库。全面基于 Tailwind CSS 构建，它通过精妙的微光边框、暗色背景对比与触觉悬浮反馈，让普通的界面控件呈现出如同高端硬件工艺品般的设计质感。
